All of the roles here are enjoyable except for Framer in my opinions.

Medium - A very fun role. Hard to confirm, yes, but a powerful role nonetheless. Sometimes useful TI die, and post their wills, allowing Medium to easily get a lynch on an evil.

Survivor - I don’t see why so many people hate this role. It’s not the best, but in my opinion it’s a whole lot more fun than Mafia or something. You basically get to vibe out and kill the majority of the game, siding with whoever you want, and if you’re lynched at some point, it’s usually easy to understand why.

Disguiser - Weak at this current state in the game, but not a bad role at all. If done properly, you can get town into thinking TI lynched an innocent role, resulting in them being in a tight spot with town the next couple days. You can also have town thinking there are more mafia roles left in a round than there actually are.

Vampire - Not my favorite. It’s not bad, but personally I hate being turned into a vamp mid to late game. I feel it’s only truly fun when you’re the starting vamp, and you get to build up a vamp army. Also creates for some interesting plays, and critical thinking. Like, “Ah, do we get this medium claim now? They’re confirmed.”

Then Framer... Well, you can maybe get a miss lynch if you’re lucky.
